title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI Workflows & Anthropic Shift: Anthropic reported that over 90% of internal code is now generated by Claude Code, shifting software roles away from frontend/backend silos toward rapid prototyping and system architecture.

Model Scaling & Scientific AI: Ollama expanded capacity for DeepSeek-V4-Flash amid record token usage, while the US Department of Energy partnered with Arcee.ai on Genesis-Science-1 for open scientific computing.
Orbital Infrastructure & Compute: SpaceX partnered with NVIDIA to design 'Starmind' space-based data center satellite payloads, establishing orbital compute as a major frontier in AI hardware.

Energy Constraints in AI: Former Citadel quants emphasized that power grid access and electrical generation—rather than GPU supply—have become the primary bottleneck for massive AI data center scaling.

Market Dynamics & DIY Hardware: Passive equity index strategies continued to outperform active traders, while developer communities shared practical startup post-mortems and hardware hacks using cellular modems.

items.title: @xiaohu: 90% of Anthropic's Code Is Now Written by Claude Code
items.body: Boris revealed that 90% of internal code at Anthropic is generated by Claude Code, with engineers operating as 100% AI-assisted builders since late 2025. Engineering roles are evolving beyond frontend/backend divisions into agile prototypers and full-stack builders.

items.title: @neelsomani: Electricity Grid Is the Central Bottleneck for AI Datacenters
items.body: A former Citadel energy quant noted that while hardware discussions focus heavily on GPU chips and memory, electrical power and grid interconnects represent the true rate-limiting factor for expanding AI computing capacity.

items.title: @ollama: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Sees Record Growth on Ollama Platform
items.body: Ollama announced rapid infrastructure expansion across North America and Europe to keep pace with DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, its fastest-growing model in token volume with zero data retention and 100+ tps performance.

items.title: @arcee_ai: US Department of Energy Partners with Arcee.ai for Open Science Model
items.body: Arcee.ai announced a formal partnership with the US Department of Energy to create Genesis-Science-1, an open-weight model and research harness engineered specifically for complex scientific workflows.

items.title: @theo: Luna AI Model Cost Reduction Enables Low-Cost Data Processing
items.body: Tech creator Theo highlighted Luna's 80% price reduction, making large-scale automated data transformation and metadata processing extremely cost-effective for production applications.

items.title: @ishm6m: Open Weight Releases Drive Competitive AI Landscape
items.body: Developers contrasted frontier release strategies across major labs, highlighting open weights and instant repository accessibility from Qwen alongside rapid ecosystem adoption.

items.title: @zerohedge: SpaceX Partners with NVIDIA on 'Starmind' Space Datacenters
items.body: Reports surfaced detailing SpaceX's collaboration with NVIDIA to equip satellite constellations with 'Starmind' orbital AI datacenter payloads, leveraging space-based power and thermal advantages.
